validity.recommendation: Change Owner/Operator from 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) to the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) / Iranian Gas Transmission Co. (operating via its Region 6 / Kerman Province Gas Co.). Existence, gas + transmission classification, diameter and province all stand; keep Proposal 2003 / Start 2005 flagged as single-source (uncorroborated).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — CONFIRMED. The GEM row's ONLY citation is iranertebat.com (an EPC contractor's project portfolio listing '10- and 12-inch gas transmission pipeline, Zarand-Ravar'); that domain is currently network-unreachable (ConnectTimeout / ECONNREFUSED) so it fails url_verifier and cannot be cited, and it is not independent corroboration on its own. However, Mizan Online (independent general/judiciary news agency; verified 200 + 'راور' present) reports pigging/maintenance on '۶۰ کیلومتر از خط ۱۰ اینچ راور' — 60 km of the 10-inch Ravar line — run by Region 6 of the gas-transmission operations. That independently confirms a real, operating Ravar gas transmission line at the 10-inch diameter GEM lists, and Zarand + Ravar are both real Kerman-province towns ~57 km apart. So the pipeline is genuine, not phantom. CLASSIFICATION — CONFIRMED gas + transmission ('خط انتقال گاز', Region 6 gas-transmission operations); 10/12-inch is small but consistent with sibling Kerman/Razavi-Khorasan feeder-transmission rows GEM already carries. DUPLICATE — NONE. No match in the 31-row Iran-gas operating roster and no GulfPub counterpart (GulfPub's Kerman-area 'Sarkhun - Kerman / Rafsanjan-Anar' lines are different towns and diameters); distinct line. ATTRIBUTION — CONCERN: GEM Owner = 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) is wrong for a domestic town-supply gas transmission line. Mizan attributes operation to the gas-transmission company (NIGC subsidiary, Region 6), and GulfPub consistently attributes Iran's domestic gas lines to NIGC while reserving NIOC for trunk/offshore/international lines. Owner should be NIGC (Iranian Gas Transmission Co. / Kerman Province Gas Co.), not NIOC. Also FuelSource = 'Zarand' is dubious — Zarand is the start town, not a gas field/source; the line is fed off the national grid, so FuelSource is a mislabeled endpoint (minor). SPEC — Diameter '12,10' corroborated (Iran Ertebat = 10 and 12 inch; Mizan = 10 inch). Length 106 km partially corroborated (Mizan confirms a 60 km 10-inch segment; a 12-inch balance to ~106 km is plausible but not independently confirmed). Capacity blank (left blank; weak field). Proposal 2003 / Start 2005 trace only to the sheet's single Iran-Ertebat source and are NOT independently corroborated — flag, do not treat as verified.

routes.corridor_desc: Runs generally north / north-northeast across northern Kerman Province from the town of Zarand to the town of Ravar. Straight-line separation is ~57 km; the stated 106 km pipe length implies it follows terrain/road (the Zarand-Ravar road corridor) rather than a straight shot, and Mizan describes it as built in a 10-inch segment (~60 km) plus (per Iran Ertebat) a 12-inch segment. Endpoints are well-bounded (two named towns); the intermediate path is NOT traced — corridor bound is town-to-town only, no sourced waypoints.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints are the two named Kerman-province towns Zarand and Ravar (coordinates are the real, well-known town centers, not fabricated). Mizan confirms an operating 10-inch Ravar gas line under Region 6 gas-transmission operations, anchoring the Ravar end and the corridor's existence; the exact routed geometry between the towns is not published, so accuracy stays low. No coordinates were invented — no intermediate waypoint could be sourced, so waypoints left empty.

summary: P6030 real + correctly gas/transmission (Mizan confirms operating 10-inch Ravar line, Region 6); ATTRIBUTION concern — Owner should be NIGC not NIOC; Proposal 2003/Start 2005 single-source. Route: Zarand→Ravar town-to-town corridor, suggested accuracy low.
